_how_to_use: Add this 'estate' block to the client's fact-find JSON, then run scripts/legacy_plan.py on it. Values in SGD. Leave unknowns null. Names are first names only. No NRIC, policy numbers or bank details.

estate._confirmed_note: false until the client has confirmed will/nomination status; unknowns then show as ? (not x) in the client PDF

assets.name: HDB flat
assets._note: cpf_refund = CPF used for the flat + accrued interest; 'to' = who the client wants to have it

assets.name: CPF (all accounts)
assets._note: nominees e.g. {"Child A": 0.5, "Child B": 0.5}; empty = no nomination

wish._note: equal: list heirs. shares: e.g. {"Child A": 60, "Child B": 40}. Specific assets go in each asset's 'to'.
